question: The code on social security extends social security to__________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**organised or unorganised sector employee**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__
 
 
 
• The **Code on Social Security, 2020** consolidates and simplifies the existing labor laws relating to social security and applies to employees in both **organised** and **unorganised sectors**. 
 
• The code aims to provide **universal social security** coverage to all workers, including those in the **gig economy** and **platform-based workers**. 
 
• It ensures that workers in the unorganised sector—such as **daily wage earners**, **self-employed individuals**, and **migrant laborers**—are brought under the umbrella of social security schemes such as **provident fund, health insurance, and maternity benefits**. 
 
• The code mandates the establishment of a **Social Security Fund** to support unorganised workers and gig workers, ensuring their inclusion in welfar
